why.h: Most AI ventures stall not from technology, but from fragmented execution.
why.p: We work hands-on with founders to move beyond pilots — refining models, launching in live markets, and building traction that attracts serious capital.

about.title: About
about.mission: Venture Hub Academy builds and scales AI-driven businesses by partnering with experienced operators — transforming domain expertise into high-growth, technology-enabled ventures.

crit.text: Quality of team / visionaries of an established business
Potentially groundbreaking product or service based on unique technologies
Clear, proven commercial proposition with global opportunities

about.who: Venture Hub Academy prioritizes experienced operators over first-time, idea-stage founders. We look for teams with an established commercial foundation who are ready to execute — not validate an idea from zero.

acc.title: Accelerator

ov.text: Small, focused cohorts of up to 10 companies.
US$150K via SAFE plus GPU and compute resources.

p1: 1-on-1 mentoring by experienced founders and operators.
Corporate structuring support, research direction, and product strategy.
p2: Live customer validation across 6 markets: HK, TW, SG, JP, TH, Cambodia.
Real revenue signals through live sales, partnerships, or LOIs.
acc.ddH: Present live metrics. Raise on evidence.
acc.dd: Founders present live metrics to investors and community. Structured investor access and community-driven momentum.

com.title: Community
com.funnelH: From open forum to core cohort.
com.t1d: Open network, discussing startup ideas, early intent surfacing.
com.t2d: Alumni and shortlisted participants, access to exclusive events.
com.t3d: 10+ selectively chosen teams, direct funding and network access.

apply.title: Fifteen minutes. Read by a partner.

steps.d: This form. Reviewed on a rolling basis — we respond to every application within 14 days.
Two conversations, product-deep. With partners, not associates.
US$150K via SAFE on standard terms, and a start date for the next cohort.

apply.noteP: Plain answers beat polished ones. Numbers where you have them, links where you can. A deck is optional.
apply.oneLine: What does your company do, in one sentence?
apply.tech: What proprietary technology or unique commercial advantage do you have?
apply.traction: What traction do you have today?
apply.why: Why do you need capital, compute, or market access specifically in Asia/APAC right now?
apply.hear: How did you hear about us?
apply.relocateQ: Are you open to relocating or spending time on-site during the program?
apply.anything: Anything else you'd like us to know?
apply.submitHelp: Reviewed on a rolling basis · Response within 14 days
apply.doneP: A partner will read your application this cycle. You'll hear back within 14 days, either way.
apply.doneLink: Meanwhile, join the community — every cohort started there.

footer.stayP: Join our newsletter and stay updated on the latest news.
